steps.title: Measure handler intervals
steps.explanation: Record start and end times on a monotonic clock. Weather includes a labelled seven-hundred-millisecond teaching delay. Only intersecting observed intervals count as overlap.

steps.title: Return a friendly tool failure
steps.explanation: An intentional local HTTP 503 becomes a composed isError result. It is not a successful data response, and the model is asked not to retry.
steps.narration: Step 7. An intentional local HTTP 503 becomes a composed isError result. It is not a successful data response, and the model is asked not to retry. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Observe exception conversion
steps.explanation: This controlled uncaught handler exception is converted by the SDK MCP server to an error tool result. Other kinds of SDK or transport failures can still end a query.
steps.narration: Step 8. This controlled uncaught handler exception is converted by the SDK MCP server to an error tool result. Other kinds of SDK or transport failures can still end a query. This source excerpt shows the corresponding application statement.

steps.title: Encode an actual PNG
steps.explanation: The handler fetches the bundled sample PNG and returns raw base64 with image/png. The source image is labelled classroom data, not live weather.

steps.explanation: The resource carries its Markdown text inline. The classroom URI is a label; no filesystem read from that URI is implied.
